data.spiritual_significance: The name "Mutabassim" holds deep spiritual significance in Islamic tradition as it symbolizes submission to Allah's will and living a life in accordance with the divine guidance. Mutabassim is a persona of surrender, of humility, and of being fully committed to guided living. It represents the essence of tawheed (monotheism) and the ultimate goal of every Muslim, which is to attain closeness to Allah and achieve eternal peace and happiness in the hereafter.
